name: 侠客行一百
group_note: 侠客行一百 (Coollizard & xkx100, 2003-2004, yoyo.xm.fj.cn/xkx100). Distinct from the separately-completed GitHub fluffos/xkx100 repo (different codebase, unrelated). WASM pass fixed 6 distinct compile/runtime bugs: (1) §7.48-class 'private' function called from an inheriting file: feature/treemap.lpc's _set()/_query()/_delete() were private, but feature/dbase.lpc (which inherits F_TREEMAP) calls them directly -- changed to protected, exact match to AGENTS.md's documented pattern. (2) The SAME §7.48 pattern independently in feature/action.lpc's continue_action() and feature/attack.lpc's attack(), both called from /inherit/char/char.lpc -- also changed private to protected. (3) §7.47-class origin()==ORIGIN_X int-bitmask comparison in feature/team.lpc's follow_path() (this driver's origin() returns a string) -- fixed to origin()=="local"/"internal" per the documented mapping. (4) A genuine missing-file robustness bug in adm/daemons/logind.lpc: howmany_visitor()/howmany_card() called sscanf() on the result of read_file() without checking it was a string first -- log/MUDVISITOR genuinely does not exist anywhere in this archive (confirmed absent even in raw/), so a truly fresh install hits this on the very first connection, before the id prompt even appears (the sscanf(0, ...) type-mismatch error is swallowed silently by the driver mid-logon(), hanging the connection with no error text and no prompt) -- added stringp(content) guards returning 0 on a missing file, matching the case this lib's own code clearly anticipated (num defaults to 0) but didn't implement safely. (5) A bad #include path in adm/daemons/combatd.lpc: '#include </quest/quest.h>' (absolute path syntax) doesn't resolve under this driver's include-directory search rules (config.fluffos sets 'include directories : /include'); every other active file needing the same quest_finished()/quest_failed()/lock_quest() helpers already uses '#include <quest.h>' (which resolves to /include/quest.h, a near-identical newer copy) -- switched combatd.lpc to match. (6) A knock-on 'Illegal to inherit after defining global variables' once fix 5 let the header actually load: quest.h declares a global quest_name mapping, which landed before combatd.lpc's 'inherit F_DBASE;' line -- moved the #include after the inherit statement (the safest place, since #include is pure text substitution and the inherit-then-globals ordering rule just needed satisfying). §8.1-class is_chinese() in adm/simul_efun/chinese.lpc was already a correct per-codepoint check; only check_legal_name()'s OWN separate i%2 gate and byte-count length bound (4-10, meant to be 2-5 characters) needed the same standard fix (per-character is_chinese(name[i..i]), length bound corrected to 2-5). Admin seeded: fluffos (admin) in adm/etc/wizlist (multiple existing (admin)/(arch)/(wizard) accounts; SECURITY_D correctly points at /adm/daemons/securityd). Registration flow verified end-to-end in one continuous WASM client session: English id -> y/n create-confirm -> Chinese name -> password + confirm -> birthplace selection (1-5) -> stat-point allocation (3 explicit inputs, 4th stat auto-computed as the remainder) -> y to accept -> personality-trait menu (0 for none) -> email (id@address format) -> gender (m/f) -> enters world with a full character sheet and working 'score'/'look' commands, zero unexpected errors. Admin permission directly confirmed via 'wizlist' command output showing '目前权限：(admin)' with fluffos listed among the top (admin) tier. LPC formatter run across all 14255 .lpc files (14237 written, 2 errors, 16 unchanged). No :: parent-call split hits, no CJK-respacing hits, no case-label-with-trailing-comment candidates. All 8 map.lpc files confirmed content-identical (whitespace-only) to their pre-format blobs. Post-formatter re-verified with the same full registration flow -- clean, admin permission still (admin).
